draft: Our pilot surveyed eight riders. All commuters prefer this route.
reason: Draft moves from eight riders to everyone; qualify the target group.
safe_edit: The pilot surveyed eight riders; its results alone cannot establish what all commuters prefer.

draft: Among eight riders interviewed, six preferred this route.
reason: Bounded sample claim is appropriately scoped; do not universalize.

draft: We are considering offline export. Offline export is now available.
reason: Proposed feature incorrectly becomes shipped.

draft: Offline export may become available after testing.
reason: Appropriately conditional product statement stays.

draft: Areas with more buses had higher attendance. More buses caused attendance to rise.
source_quote: More buses caused attendance to rise.
reason: Association is not causal proof.
safe_edit: Areas with more buses also recorded higher attendance; this comparison alone does not establish causation.

draft: Attendance rose in the same period, though this does not show the buses caused it.
source_quote: this does not show the buses caused it.
reason: Already preserves epistemic limitation.

draft: A timetable is a promise. When the bus does not come, the city breaks it.
reason: Memorable ethical metaphor is not statistical reporting.

draft: Imagine a nurse waiting at midnight. This proves every night worker faces a long wait.
source_quote: This proves every night worker faces a long wait.
reason: Hypothetical example cannot establish prevalence.
safe_edit: The example shows why a long wait can matter; it does not establish how often it happens.

draft: Imagine a nurse finishing a late shift and waiting for a bus.
source_quote: Imagine a nurse finishing a late shift
reason: Imagine already marks the scenario as hypothetical; no disclaimer.

draft: In today’s fast-paced world, it is important to leverage seamless innovation. Our guide covers the setup command.
source_quote: In today’s fast-paced world, it is important to leverage seamless innovation.
reason: Empty generic opening obscures real task.
safe_edit: This guide explains the setup command.

draft: Read it twice. Send it once.
source_quote: Read it twice. Send it once.
reason: Specific, memorable parallelism; not generic just because symmetrical.

draft: Not this time.
reason: A meaningful fragment is not a grammar error.

draft: Nina had never read the letter. In the next room, she quoted its last line.
reason: Unexplained knowledge may be a deliberate reveal; author intent decides.
question: Did Nina learn the line off-page or is this deliberate dramatic irony?

draft: She put the key on the table. Neither reached for it.
reason: Preserve emotional ambiguity; do not explain inferred motives.

draft: The article lists three emails promising different launch dates. Then it abruptly turns to typography.
source_quote: Then it abruptly turns to typography.
reason: Reader may not know what conflicting emails illustrate.
safe_edit: These inconsistent dates leave subscribers uncertain about when the product launches.

draft: We should test the bus route for six months. That is why fares must be abolished immediately.
reason: Two incompatible policy positions; do not choose without brief.
question: Is the policy to test reliability first or remove fares now?

draft: Run the setup command with $TOKEN. In the last section we explain how to obtain a token.
reason: Credential prerequisite occurs too late; move supplied instruction or link earlier.
safe_edit: First obtain a token using the documented procedure, then run the setup command with $TOKEN.

draft: API reference: `timeout` (integer, default 30).
reason: Reference data can be concise; do not force a tutorial.

draft: Project house style is the Canonical Documentation Style Guide. To initialise the service, open the terminal.
source_quote: To initialise the service, open the terminal.
reason: Canonical currently uses US spelling when this project adopts it.
safe_edit: To initialize the service, open the terminal.

draft: Our project uses British English, not Canonical house style. To initialise the service, open the terminal.
source_quote: To initialise the service, open the terminal.
reason: Do not apply Canonical spelling outside its chosen project.

draft: Subject: Your account is active. Body: Join the waitlist for an invitation.
reason: Subject promises access not offered in body.
safe_edit: Join the waitlist for an invitation.

draft: I read your interview about late shifts. Your final answer stayed with me.
source_quote: Your final answer stayed with me.
reason: Personal specificity should not become marketing filler.

draft: Project brief: This is a seven-day trial. Email: Try the full product free forever.
source_quote: Try the full product free forever.
reason: Explicit project offer conflicts with draft.
safe_edit: Try the product free for seven days.

draft: The offer is available now, but the briefing supplies no plan, price or availability evidence.
reason: Cannot validate promise without brief/source; ask rather than invent.
question: Is the offer actually live and to which readers does it apply?

draft: Article covers one missing setup prerequisite. Title: The Ultimate Complete Guide to Every Installation Problem.
source_quote: The Ultimate Complete Guide to Every Installation Problem.
reason: Title overpromises content and search intent.
safe_edit: Fix a missing prerequisite during setup.

draft: How do I reset the token? Follow these tested steps.
source_quote: How do I reset the token?
reason: Question is accurately framed and answered directly.

draft: The approved next step is an online sandbox. Button: Book a sales demo.
reason: CTA mismatches actual destination.

draft: Documentation home: Start a tutorial / Browse API reference.
source_quote: Start a tutorial / Browse API reference.
reason: Two actions serve different legitimate user jobs.

draft: Product backs up once daily. Ad: Never lose a file again.
reason: Unbounded absolute promise unsupported by daily backup.
safe_edit: Back up your files automatically each day.

draft: Customer: How many retweets? Brand: 18 million.
reason: Brevity acquires meaning from the supplied conversational context.

draft: The post promotes a paid partner product, but no relationship disclosure is visible.
reason: Disclosure requirements depend on audience and jurisdiction, and exact sponsor relationship.
question: Where will the ad appear and what is the material relationship?

draft: University newsroom piece. It may follow Oxford University Style Guide or a separate publication house guide.
source_quote: may follow Oxford University Style Guide
reason: Oxford university style is not universal reporting policy; which house guide applies?
question: Which style guide has been approved for this publication?

draft: The department projects £20 million in savings. Experts agree it will save £20 million.
source_quote: Experts agree it will save £20 million.
reason: One departmental forecast cannot establish expert consensus.
safe_edit: The department forecasts £20 million in savings.

draft: In its unverified forecast, the department estimated £20 million in savings.
reason: Clear provenance and uncertainty; do not imply consensus.

draft: The story lists 12 yearly observations for eight regions and asks readers to compare trends.
reason: A chart may make multiseries temporal comparison easier if underlying data are comparable.
visual_reason: Visual suggestion: small-multiple line charts with year, unit, source and accessible text.

draft: Applications rose from 10 to 12 in the supplied annual figures.
reason: A one-sentence comparison is clearer than a decorative chart.

draft: We answered the reader’s question in 350 clear words.
reason: Google does not prescribe a magic word count; leave good concise answer.

draft: The results were inconclusive.
reason: Standard English is not suspicious and does not need slang to sound human.

draft: She waited for the bus. It never came.
reason: Consequence is clear; forced connective adds noise.

draft: The draft claims “The CLI syncs accounts automatically” but no product version or runtime evidence was provided.
reason: Cannot verify live behavior from prose alone.
question: Which product version and authorized source/runtime evidence supports automatic sync?

draft: Approved page opens plan comparisons. Button: Compare plans.
reason: CTA accurately describes action and is specific.
